camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus --region cn-hangzhou --StatusList.1.Site global --StatusList.1.AttackLogStatus 1 --StatusList.1.DeliveryType sls --StatusList.1.ProtoLogStatus 1 --DeliveryType sls --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the protocol log and attack log delivery switches for specified sites in a batch. You must pass a non-empty StatusList and explicitly specify the target switch values for both log types for each site. Call DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus to retrieve the current configuration first
description_zh: 批量更新指定站点的协议日志和攻击日志投递开关。调用时必须传入非空 StatusList，并为每个站点明确传入两类日志的目标开关值；可先调用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 读取当前配置
name: UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en: A compatibility parameter. Set this parameter to sls. The actual update uses the DeliveryType value specified in each item of StatusList. Passing only this parameter does not update the switches
parameters.help_zh: 兼容参数，取值为 sls。当前更新以 StatusList 中各项的 DeliveryType 为准，仅传入本参数不会更新开关
parameters.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en: The target switch value for attack log delivery. A value of 0 indicates disabled. A value of 1 indicates enabled. Explicitly specify this parameter. If omitted, the value defaults to 0
fields.help_zh: 攻击日志投递的目标开关值。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。请显式传入；省略时按 0 处理
fields.name: attack_log_status

fields.help_en: The log delivery type. Set this parameter to sls for each site
fields.help_zh: 投递类型，每个站点均须传入 sls
fields.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en: The target switch value for protocol log delivery. A value of 0 indicates disabled. A value of 1 indicates enabled. Explicitly specify this parameter. If omitted, the value defaults to 0
fields.help_zh: 协议日志投递的目标开关值。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。请显式传入；省略时按 0 处理
fields.name: proto_log_status

fields.help_en: The identifier of the site to update. This parameter cannot be empty. Use the site returned by DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus
fields.help_zh: 待更新的站点标识，不能为空。使用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 返回的站点
fields.name: site

parameters.help_en: The list of switch configurations for the sites to update. This parameter cannot be empty. Each item must explicitly include DeliveryType, Site, ProtoLogStatus, and AttackLogStatus. Only the sites included in the list are updated
parameters.help_zh: 待更新站点的开关配置列表，不能为空。每项需明确传入 DeliveryType、Site、ProtoLogStatus 和 AttackLogStatus；只更新列表中的站点
parameters.name: status_list

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
